about: Scene 8, Pier Nine, by real input (node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/warehouse.json): the side door; crouched in the dark while the first man crosses the door's pool; up aisle A behind him into a dark pocket in the stacks; a bottle from a crate, the knife switch (aisle B goes dark and its man walks over to put it back) and into a pocket out of his way; up aisle A behind his back; the bottle lobbed along the north strip past the Hoods at the foot of the stairs turns them; round under the mezzanine and up the dark side of the stairs; the office window, the Cardinal's order, down and still under his look; the truck backs against the side door; along the catwalk, the far stairs when both torches turn away, out through the bay door onto the pier. Never seen. The waits are what a player who watches does: each until is a man's round turning.
